history.summary: Freehold (2008) 969 sqft 3BR boutique near the Paya Lebar/Geylang border at $1.8M / $1,858 psf. Only 4 URA transactions means no reliable appreciation read; an efficient FH 3BR at a liquid quantum is decent, but the thin data and fringe location keep it Neutral.
history.rating_rationale: A 969 sqft freehold 3BR is efficiently sized (good for resale) and $1.8M is in the deep buyer band, but only 4 URA transactions makes any appreciation estimate unreliable, score_1000 of 498 is dead-market-typical, and $1,858 psf is full for a 2008 boutique on the Geylang fringe of D15 (810m to Paya Lebar). Freehold tenure and efficient layout are real, but there's no data edge and no clear catalyst — a hold-neutral.
red_flags: Only 4 URA transactions — appreciation unverifiable, thin liquidity
